# Rabbit Chain

Official website: https://rabbitchain.org
Official GitHub: https://github.com/rabbitmainnet
Official X: https://x.com/rabbit_mainnet

Rabbit Chain is a permissionless EVM Layer 1 powered by Live Consensus Queue (LCQ). Rabbit Chain Testnet is live, with Chain ID and Network ID 9280 and native test asset tRAB. Mainnet has yet to launch.

Rabbit Core Testnet v2.4.25 source: https://github.com/rabbitmainnet/rabbit-geth/tree/4f502f971c3b3166be14da6e25fbc7c531404d42
Official packages and SHA-256 checksums: https://rabbitchain.org/releases/
Historical Whitepaper v1.7 and the v2.4.25 technical addendum: https://rabbitchain.org/whitepaper/

Fresh installations prepare an encrypted wallet, verify and resume the official multipart bootstrap at block 385509 (approximately 7.49 GiB compressed), then synchronize the remaining canonical blocks. Upgrades reuse the existing data directory, encrypted wallet, node identity and participation state. Extracting the program elsewhere does not relocate the data directory.

RandomX Work V2 admission is wallet-bound. ADMISSION_PENDING awaits canonical activation. ACTIVE_SEAT indicates a persistent LCQ seat and ends normal admission work. The synchronized node stays online and produces automatically when assigned. PENALIZED reports canonical expiry and remaining blocks. After expiry, the wallet still needs synchronization and selection. See https://rabbitchain.org/mining/ and https://rabbitchain.org/lcq/.

The 70/30 block subsidy allocation applies when an eligible committee exists. The producer may receive the full subsidy when no eligible committee exists. Emergency registry fallback with zero eligible WorkSeats can advance the chain without minting the normal subsidy.

V2.4.25 includes synchronization recovery and miner cancellation changes, DKG artifact replay changes and revised VRF finalization gossip. The historical activation schedule is preserved: VRF DKG preparation at 136065, VRF protocol and liveness at 136193, Availability V2 at 173057, VRF economics V2 and WorkSeat admission V2 at 320000, and WorkSeat liveness V2 at 323800. VRF fulfillment must be verified against canonical request status and proof. Laboratory results do not establish public-network performance.

Testnet RPC: https://rpc-testnet.rabbitchain.org
Testnet WebSocket: wss://rpc-testnet.rabbitchain.org/ws
Testnet Explorer: https://explorer-testnet.rabbitchain.org

One wallet. One fair chance.
Use the computer you already have.
No farms. No privileged miners.
